name: Capitol: the greeter breaks script
when: return root.Save.Quest.Stage == QuestStage.threePaths && ((root.Save.Quest.EvidenceArchive && root.Save.Quest.EvidenceLedger) || (root.Save.Quest.EvidenceArchive && root.Save.Quest.EvidenceFaith) || (root.Save.Quest.EvidenceLedger && root.Save.Quest.EvidenceFaith));

g1.say: Hello, traveler! Welcome to the best planet of the— ...no. No, you've heard that line. You've heard it EVERY time, haven't you. And you keep coming back with truths in your pockets.

options.label: Show
options.text: I know what this world is. I have proof.

options.label: Kind
options.text: Take your time. Say it however you need to.

g2.say: Under the Capitol there's a door I'm not supposed to remember between... between VISITS. The Old Console. Where the world said its first words. Your proof is the key — I can feel the door listening to it.

g4.say: The shaft is dark, traveler. DARK dark. Old-world dark. Bring a light that works where light was never installed... the ice-fishers of Europa carry such things. And traveler — thank you for not finishing my line for me.
